meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo on Codex. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo UserPromptSubmit hook injects a short bootstrap that points at this file. Read the whole file and follow every rule in it for the rest of the task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 切换 ultrawork 模式以遵循特定指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在 Codex 上开发时需要启用 ultrawork 模式
copy.tagline_en: Switch to ultrawork mode to follow specific instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to enable ultrawork mode on Codex

howto.what: 你说 ultrawork 或 ulw 后,Claude 会先宣告进入超工作模式,然后不再边做边讲,而是先定目标、列检查清单,把每步改动先做成失败的测试,再改成通过,最后用真实运行结果证明任务完成。
howto.when: 当对话里出现“ultrawork”或“ulw”这两个词时触发；之后本次任务的每一步都按这个文件的规则执行。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式修一下登录接口的 500 错误。
say.note: 会先定目标、写失败测试,再用真实请求验证。

say.text: 进入 ulw 模式,给这个服务加一个新增接口。
say.note: 任务较重时会走重型流程:多条成功标准加评审。

say.text: 用 ultrawork,先写失败测试,再让实现通过。
say.note: 标准做法是红→绿:先看到失败证据再写实现。

howto.what_en: On ultrawork or ulw, Claude announces the mode, registers a goal and visible todos, writes failing tests before code (RED→GREEN), and proves the result on the real surface (HTTP, browser, terminal) before finishing.
howto.when_en: Triggered whenever the user prompt contains `ultrawork` or `ulw`; the hook injects a bootstrap pointing to this directive, and every step of the rest of the task follows the file's rules.

say_en.text: Fix the 500 error on the login endpoint using ultrawork mode.
say_en.note: Goal first, RED then GREEN, verified by a real request.

say_en.text: Enter ulw mode and add a new endpoint to this service.
say_en.note: Heavy tier likely: multiple success criteria plus a review loop.

say_en.text: Use ultrawork: write the failing test first, then make it pass.
say_en.note: The standard RED→GREEN loop with captured evidence.
